_doc: What tools/tasks/km24.py measures and against what. map: the index of km24 in project/data/catalog/maps.json; scene: the measuring scene (tests/perf/camera_pan.gd, its movements); profile: the median profile as this machine runs it (doc/specification.md, Reference hardware: --gpu-index 0, logical processors 0-11); budgets: the median profile's at medium (doc/specification.md, Budgets: frame p90 16.7 ms, no frame over 33 ms on a camera path, GPU p90 13 ms, main thread CPU 8 ms a frame, video memory 4 GB in km24), each judged per movement.
